title: Table of contents
slide_intent: Give readers several ways into a long guide. Section groupings help a reader decide whether to look for a brand idea, a design rule or a usage condition.
strategic_value: Slack can put its definition, design system and governance in one book while keeping their purposes distinct.
demonstration: The contents index groups numbered topics under three section headings. The design section begins in the left column and continues at the top of the right column above governance.
practical_value: Locate a specific topic by section and page number. Keep a long group legible when it continues in a second column.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Place the small bold title at upper left above a horizontal rule spanning the page.

content_islands.name: Section index
content_islands.spec: Use two columns with a narrow page-number rail in each. Bold the three section headings and list the topics beneath them in reading order.

content_islands.name: Running footer
content_islands.spec: Below a thin rule at the foot, align the folio, book title and Table of contents section label.
